html:
Explore the most iconic attractions in South Phu Quoc, including Coconut Tree Prison, Pearl Farm, Ho Quoc Pagoda, and Sao Beach, accompanied by a professional tour guide.

Enjoy one of the most outstanding experiences in Phu Quoc: a ride on the world’s longest three-wire cable car to Thom Island, offering breathtaking panoramic views of fishing villages and southern islands.

Arrive at Aquatopia Water Park, one of Southeast Asia’s most modern water parks, featuring more than twenty thrilling games and attractions.

ITINERARY

08:45 – 09:00

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

  • Pearl Farm: Introduction to pearl cultivation

  • Ho Quoc Pagoda: Buddhist temple visit

  • Coconut Tree Prison: War museum

  • Sao Beach: Lunch (if booked with lunch), relaxing and swimming

  • Cable car station check-in

  • Cable car ride to Thom Island (approximately twenty-five minutes)

  • Aquatopia Water Park: Enjoy more than twenty modern water games

16:30

Return to your hotel.

TOUR PRICE

Without Lunch

  • Adults (from one hundred forty centimeters in height): 44 United States dollars per person

  • Children (from one hundred centimeters to under one hundred forty centimeters in height): 38 United States dollars per child

  • Children under one hundred centimeters in height: Free of charge

With Lunch

  • Adults (from one hundred forty centimeters in height): 54 United States dollars per person

  • Children (from one hundred centimeters to under one hundred forty centimeters in height): 48 United States dollars per child

  • Children under one hundred centimeters in height: Free of charge

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Round-trip transportation by air-conditioned car

  • Cable car ticket and Aquatopia Water Park entrance ticket

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • One bottle of drinking water per guest

  • Set menu lunch (if booked in advance)

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

  • Additional services at Thom Island

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Aquatopia Water Park requires appropriate swimwear without zippers or buttons.

  • Guests wishing to stop at Sunset Sanato or the Night Market in Duong Dong Ward should inform the tour guide in advance. Entrance tickets and return transportation are at guests’ own expense.

  • Guests are advised to bring towels, spare clothes, swimwear, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, and some cash.

HEALTH AND SAFETY NOTICE

  • This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility or wheelchair users.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible or liable for any health-related issues during or after the tour.
